title: Getting started
sub: Install, find your lights on the LIGHTS tab, connect your phone.
html:
What you need

  • A Windows 10 or 11 laptop or PC. This is where GlowBop runs and listens to the music.
  • One or more supported LED curtains (see Supported lights).
  • Your home Wi-Fi. The lights, the computer and your phone all join the same network. (Bluetooth lights just need to be near the computer.)
  • A phone (iPhone or Android) for the remote. Optional, but it's the fun part.

1. Set up your lights

Set up each light with its maker's app first (for Twinkly, the Twinkly app). Once it shows up there and lights up, you're ready. GlowBop takes over from here.

Tip: use your main Wi-Fi, not a guest network. Guest networks often block devices from seeing each other.

2. Install and open GlowBop

  1. Download GlowBop and run GlowBop-Setup. It installs just for your Windows account, no admin password needed.
  2. If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", click More info, then Run anyway. (Your browser may also say the file "isn't commonly downloaded": choose Keep.) This shows up for new apps from small makers, not because anything is wrong.
  3. When it finishes, leave Open GlowBop now ticked and click Finish. Next time, open GlowBop from the Start menu or desktop shortcut.
  4. Paste the license key from your Polar email (it starts with GLOWBOP- for Home DJ or GBPRO- for Pro DJ) and tap Unlock.
  5. If Windows asks, allow GlowBop on private networks. That lets your phone and lights reach it.

3. Find your lights

  1. Tap LIGHTS on the side rail, in the System group at the bottom. In Your lights, tap Find my lights. GlowBop searches your Wi-Fi and Bluetooth.
  2. Each light it finds is added with its size. If one is missing, use Add by brand.
  3. Have more than one curtain? Do the line-up wizard next. It takes a minute.

Everything about your lights lives on LIGHTS: Your lights, Light groups, Layout & shape, Draw your layout, Line up my curtains and Map with camera. The Lights key under the live wall jumps straight there.

Bluetooth lights (TikTok-style pixel curtains, DayBetter strips) take one connection at a time. Close their phone app before you tap Find my lights.

4. Open the console on your phone or iPad

  1. Put your phone on the same Wi-Fi as the computer.
  2. On the laptop, tap SETUP and find Control from your phone. Point your phone camera at the QR code.
  3. The console opens in Safari or Chrome. Tap Share → Add to Home Screen to get the GlowBop icon. From then on it opens full screen, like an app.
  4. On an iPad, turn it sideways for the big two-column board.
  5. Want a friend to run the lights too? On a connected phone the same card is called Share the remote: they scan the code right off your screen, or you send the link.
Not connecting? Same Wi-Fi on both, VPN off on the phone, and allow GlowBop on private networks in Windows. More in Troubleshooting.

5. Press play

Play a song on the computer, from any app. The bar under the live wall says MUSIC SHOW · LISTENING and the wall comes alive. That's it, you're running a light show. 🎉

Next, take two minutes with Using the console to learn the rail and the keys.

title: Using the console
sub: The grouped side rail, the live wall, the mode bar and every section.
html:
The GlowBop console is the same on a phone, an iPad and the laptop. Once you know the four parts below, you know the whole app.

The side rail

The colored keys down the left side are the sections. Tap one and its controls slide in. The white edge shows where you are. The rail comes in four groups, each with a small label above it.

Perform

The home screen and playing the lights by hand.

MUSIC

Now Playing with the light style for the song (Auto, Epic, Dance, Chill or Jazz), Show control (power, next effect, shuffle, surprise me, the Eyeball switch) and Levels: pace, sparkles, brightness, blend and sync.

DJ

Build & drop, 12 hit pads, keys to skip a look or an effect, tap tempo, cue the next look, crowd lines and your DJ controller.

Visuals

Everyday looks and shows, the most used first.

LOOKS

All the looks, Feature an effect, and Transitions.

SCENES

The Fireplace at the top, then Quick scenes, Screen mirror and Describe a scene in your own words.

LIVE

11 live feeds: countdown, weather, storm watch, overhead, earthquakes, aurora, launches, moon & sun, globe, volcanoes and wildfires.

SPORTS

Game Day, Live Fan in 44 leagues with the Game Center, F1, golf, racing, tennis and UFC boards, and the countdown clock.

TEXT

Messages and your logo on top of the show, or a logo slideshow.

HOLIDAY

The holidays of your country and the mini-movies. It moves up next to LOOKS when a holiday is close.

GAMES

Eight self-playing arcade games and the Arcade marathon.

★ Pro

The Pro DJ tools. On Home DJ this group is a single gold PRO key with a tour of what Pro adds.

LOOPS & CUESPro DJ

Autoloops, your Scenes and the Tempo toolbox. A switch at the top opens the Cue list with its big GO. More

SHOWSPro DJ

Song Shows: a timeline for each song, with Auto-draft. More

LIVE BOARDPro DJ

The fader board, colour palettes, zone faders, the hit pads and the Pad Recorder. More

OVERRIDEPro DJ

Override target (a zone), eight override keys and Interlude · Ambient. More

System

Your lights and the app itself.

LIGHTS

Everything about the physical lights: Your lights (find and add), Light groups, Layout & shape, Draw your layout, Line up my curtains and Map with camera.

SETUP

License, the remote QR code, Controllers & Sync, a restart key if something isn't working, screen, console sounds, text size, song lookup, and help and feedback.

Power and Brightness, on every page

Two quick keys sit at the top of every page: Power turns the lights off and on, and Brightness opens a slider with 25, 50, 75 and 100 percent presets. No need to go back to MUSIC.

The live wall

The box with the amber frame shows exactly what your lights are showing right now, bulb by bulb. With light groups, each group shows side by side and you can tap one to control just that group.

  • Full view fills the whole screen with the wall. Tap Close to come back.
  • Mirror jumps to screen mirroring. Lights jumps to the LIGHTS tab.
  • When you're in another section on a phone, the wall shrinks so the controls have room.

The mode bar

The bar under the wall always says what's in charge of your lights, in that mode's color: Music show · listening, a pinned look, a holiday, the fireplace, a scene, a live feed or a storm alert. When something has taken over, a pink ♫ Back to music button appears next to it. One tap turns off whatever is on and the music show comes back, from any section. If a Song Show is playing, it sits out the rest of that play and comes back next time the song plays.

With Pro DJ, small chips can join the mode bar on every screen (they jump to the LIVE BOARD or OVERRIDE tab): ⛔ OVERRIDE ACTIVE while an override key is on (tap to release them all), 🔁 LOOPS while loops play (tap to stop them all) and 🎚️ FADERS when a fader is away from normal (tap to open the board). During an interlude the button reads 🎵 Back to the show.

The readouts

Under the mode bar: the tempo in BPM, the song section (intro, build, drop, break...), a level meter, the current look and effect, plus extras like the key and mood when GlowBop knows the song.

Console sound styles

Every tap makes a tiny sound, and you pick its voice in SETUP → Console sounds. Fifteen styles, all original sounds made for GlowBop: Console, Computer, Arcade, Bubble, Galaxy Rebel, Wasteland Terminal, Synthwave, Magic, Spooky, Reactor Lab, Deep Sea Deco, Test Chamber, and the soft, clean Soft Bubble, Glass and Crystal. Tap one to hear it.

  • One style: every tap uses the style you pick.
  • 🎲 My mix (the default): tap styles to add or remove them. Every tap plays a different one from your mix, never the same twice in a row.
  • 🎲 Full random: every tap is a random style from all fifteen.

Each phone or iPad remembers its own.

Screen and help

  • SFX at the top turns the console's sounds on or off.
  • Screen stays on: after your first tap, your phone or iPad won't drop to the lock screen while GlowBop is open. Turn it off in SETUP → Screen to save battery.
  • Text size: SETUP → Text size makes the words bigger or smaller. Each phone or iPad remembers its own.
  • Something not working? SETUP has a 🔄 Restart GlowBop key that restarts the laptop app from your phone in about 10 seconds.
  • Can't reach the laptop? If your phone loses the laptop (wrong Wi-Fi, laptop asleep, GlowBop closed), a friendly "taking a breather" screen shows what to check and reconnects by itself the moment the laptop is back.
  • Help & feedback at the bottom sends us a bug report or a feature idea straight from the app.
iPad tip: turn the iPad sideways. The wall moves to the left and stays put while you scroll the controls on the right.

title: Line up & draw your layout
sub: Line up up to 8 curtains, draw your house or stage, and map lights with a camera.
html:
Lights that aren't curtains, on a house or a stage? Skip to Draw your layout. With more than one curtain (up to 8), GlowBop needs to know three things: which way is up on each one, whether any are mirrored, and what order they hang in. The wizard makes it a one-minute job.

Run the wizard

  1. Tap LIGHTS and, in Line up my curtains, tap Line up my curtains.
  2. Every curtain now shows a big number and an UP arrow.
  3. For each curtain, tap ⟳ to rotate until the arrow points up, and ⇋ if the number reads backwards. Use ⇅ to flip top to bottom.
  4. Use ▲ ▼ to put them in the order they hang, left to right.
  5. Choose how they hang: Side by side, Stacked, Grid or Overlap.
  6. Tap Lock.
Locked means nothing changes by accident. To move curtains later, run the wizard again and lock it when you are done.

Grid walls: up to 8 curtains

Hang curtains in rows and columns, like a video wall: 2 × 2, 3 × 2, 4 × 2 and more, up to 8 curtains.

  1. In the wizard, choose Grid.
  2. Tap the shape your curtains make. The picker shows every rows-by-columns layout that fits your curtains.
  3. Tap each spot and choose which numbered curtain hangs there. A spot can stay empty for an L-shape or a gap.
  4. Check the arrows still point up, then tap Lock.
Every show resizes to the whole grid. Big flowing effects sweep across all of it, and pixel art stays sharp.

Overlapping curtains: a denser wall

Hang two curtains over each other, with the second one shifted so its bulbs sit in the gaps of the first. Mixing brands works too, like a small Twinkly centered inside a bigger Bluetooth curtain. Same space, twice the bulbs, and GlowBop draws the picture twice as sharp to match.

→

Sideways

Shifted half a gap left or right. Rows stay level, columns double up.

↓

Down

Shifted half a row down. Columns stay lined up, rows double up.

↘

Diagonal

Shifted half a gap both ways, so every bulb sits in the middle of four others.

  1. In the wizard, choose Overlapping. The first curtain in the list is the base.
  2. Under each other curtain, pick its Place: 🎯 Center (a smaller curtain sits in the middle of the bigger one) or Top-left.
  3. Then pick its Shift ½: Sideways, Down or Diagonal, to match how you hung it.
  4. Tap 🔒 Lock it in.
Bulbs not quite in the gaps? Curtains from different brands can space their bulbs differently, and twisted wires can turn bulbs. Run camera mapping after hanging: it records exactly where every bulb landed.
You can also set it per curtain: in Your lights on the LIGHTS tab, change a curtain's Overlap to "Over" another curtain and pick the shift.

How shows fit your wall

GlowBop builds one big canvas from all your curtains. Flowing effects stretch across the whole wall. Pixel-art scenes (pumpkins, characters, the tree) keep their sharp look by showing one copy per curtain instead of getting blurry.

  • 1 curtain: everything as designed.
  • Side by side: wide shows sweep across, pixel art repeats per curtain.
  • Stacked: a taller canvas, great for fire, rain and fountains.
  • Grid: a big video-wall canvas, rows and columns together.
  • 3D shapes: see 3D shapes.

✏️ Draw your layout

Open LIGHTS → Draw your layout and tap Open editor. Photograph your house or stage, or start from a blank grid, and draw where each light string runs. Use lines, paths, arcs, rings, boxes and pixel grids, or one-tap templates.

  1. Pick the light under Your lights, then a tool, and draw the string from where it starts, in wiring order.
  2. Set how many bulbs are on that part. Bulbs tucked behind a gutter? Hide them so they take no room on the path.
  3. Tap Test: the first bulb of each string blinks green, the last blinks red, then a white light runs from start to end, so you can check the direction.
  4. Name each string (Roofline, Front window, Big tree). Every named string becomes a zone for Pro DJ.
  5. Tap Save. The show restarts with your real shapes.

Templates

Drop one on your photo, then drag the corners to fit. Effects then follow your real shapes: spirals climb trees, light runs down from the roof peaks, arches pulse from the top, and windows light up in turn on the beat. Eight shape-aware effects join the show by themselves.

📷 Camera mapping at night

Map at night, one light at a time, with the phone on a tripod. In the editor tap Map outdoors (or LIGHTS → Map with camera for a single string). GlowBop sets the brightness for you, shows how many bulbs it saw and can retry the missing ones. Then line the pieces up in the editor.

Tips: wait until it is dark and turn off porch lights. Put the phone on a tripod, a car roof or a fence post: it must not move. On iPhone, tap and hold on the lights in the Camera app first to lock the exposure.

title: Straight curtains (free 3D clips)
sub: Make your curtain bulbs line up in neat rows and columns, so pictures, logos and text look sharp.
html:
Why it matters

Curtain lights hang loose, so the wires wander and the bulbs drift out of line. GlowBop maps every bulb wherever it is, but a straight grid makes logos, text and scores look much crisper.

The free GlowBop clips

Small T-shaped clips snap onto the curtain wires and hold each bulb in place. Your curtain stays open and see-through (no big board behind it), but every row and column lines up.

  • Print them on any home 3D printer (PLA or PETG; PETG for outdoors).
  • Use the bottom clips on the lower rows: they're stronger, because a curtain leans more at the bottom.
  • Clip a row every couple of feet, top to bottom. You don't need one on every bulb.
Coming soon: the free 3D model download lands here and on glowbop.com. We're testing the first prints on real Twinkly curtains now.

No 3D printer? Quick fixes

  • Run clear fishing line tight top to bottom beside each column and zip-tie the wire to it every few bulbs.
  • Hang a light pole or PVC pipe along the bottom so the curtain can't swing.
  • Then re-run Map with camera on LIGHTS so GlowBop learns the new positions.

title: 3D shapes
sub: Wrap curtains around a cylinder, a box or a globe.
html:
Curtains bend. Wrap them around a big tube, a box or a ball and you have a glowing art piece. Tell GlowBop the shape and it wraps the picture all the way around, with no seam where the ends meet.

Pick the shape

  1. Tap LIGHTS. In Layout & shape, find Shape.
  2. Choose Flat wall, Cylinder, Box or Globe.
  3. For a cylinder or box you can pick a Curtain on top (lid). That curtain is drawn as rings that close the top.
🥫

Cylinder

Curtains wrapped around a tube or column. The picture loops around forever.

📦

Box

Curtains around the four sides of a cube or pillar, with an optional lid.

🌍

Globe

Curtains around a ball. Effects use latitude and longitude, like a planet.

The 3D preview

As soon as you pick a shape, the live wall turns into a 3D model of your piece, lit with the real show. Drag it to spin it around and look at every side.

The seamless wrap

Where the last column meets the first, GlowBop blends a narrow band so effects flow straight across the join. No hard line, no jump.

3D effects

The 3D Object look has effects made for wrapped lights. They know your shape, so a globe spins like a planet and rings rise around a column.

The clips are shown unrolled, flat. On the real piece they wrap around. Every other look works on a shape too.

Build tip: use something light and sturdy, like a pool noodle frame, a lampshade wire or a big plastic ball. Keep the curtain controller at the back.

title: Music show
sub: How the show follows a song, Epic mode, sync and song lookup.
html:
How the music show works

GlowBop listens to the sound coming out of your computer, the same sound you hear. It doesn't matter what app plays it: Spotify, YouTube, Apple Music, a DJ program, a video. Nothing to log into.

  • Kick and bass push bursts, pulses and color hits.
  • Melody moves the flowing parts.
  • Song sections: GlowBop tracks loudness over time to tell a verse from a build-up, a drop, or a breakdown.
  • Drops get a big move and usually a look change. A short gap between drops keeps it from feeling repetitive.

Show controls

Everything here lives under MUSIC, in Show control and Levels.

  • Pace: Chill slow and dreamy, Normal, Hype fast changes for a dance floor.
  • Sparkles: Off, Auto (on the high notes), Lots.
  • Brightness for the whole wall, and Blend for how smoothly effects cross-fade.
  • Surprise me throws in a random look and effect. Characters turns the pixel dancers on or off.
  • Next effect skips ahead. Pin keeps the current one going. Shuffle lets GlowBop choose.

Sync with Bluetooth speakers

Bluetooth speakers play sound about 150 to 300 milliseconds late, so the lights can look early. Slide Sync delay to the right until a kick drum and its flash land together. GlowBop remembers the setting for each speaker.

Quick test: play a song with a hard, simple kick drum and watch one curtain while you slide. When it feels "locked", stop.

Epic mode 🎬

Movie and trailer music works differently from dance music: a long crescendo, then one huge peak. GlowBop spots these songs on its own and switches to Epic mode.

  • Through the build, the wall swells: more light, more motion, warmer color.
  • Only the real climax gets the big moment, and it must top everything before it.
  • Harsh strobes are left out of Epic songs.

Light styles: Auto, Epic, Dance, Chill, Jazz

Under Now Playing on MUSIC, Light style shows what GlowBop thinks the song is. Auto shows its guess, like Auto · Rock: rock, hip-hop, Latin and Afrobeats, country and folk, kids songs and flowing melodic music each get their own looks, and epic, chill and jazz songs stay calm. A Christmas or Halloween song switches to the holiday show, in season.

Not right? Tap Epic, Dance, Chill or Jazz and GlowBop remembers it for that artist from now on. Tap Auto to let it decide again. See calm and genre looks.

Song memory

The first time a song plays, GlowBop learns its shape. Next time, it already knows where the drops and the climax are and can set up for them.

Song lookup (optional)

When GlowBop knows a song's name, it can look up its genre, tempo and key. An "orchestral" song starts in Epic mode right away; "house" stays in dance mode. You need two free keys:

  1. Last.fm (genres): sign in at last.fm, go to last.fm/api/account/create, fill in a name and description, and copy the API key.
  2. GetSongBPM (tempo and key): request a key at getsongbpm.com/api and click the activation link in your email.
  3. In GlowBop tap SETUP → Song lookup, paste each key, and tap Save.
Each song is looked up only once and saved on your computer. Your keys stay on your computer too.

title: DJ mode
sub: 13 hit pads, skip keys, build and drop, cue, tap tempo, crowd lines and DJ controllers.
html:
DJ mode puts the lights in your hands. The music show keeps running underneath, and you add moves on top, the way a lighting tech runs a club. Tap DJ on the side rail, in the Perform group.

Top to bottom, the page goes: Build & drop, the hit pads with the skip keys, tap tempo, cue the next look, crowd lines and the DJ controller.

With Pro DJ Pro DJ the fader board and the Pad Recorder live on their own LIVE BOARD tab in the Pro group, next to the same hit pads.

Hold to build

Press and hold Hold to build. The wall winds up over about 8 seconds, flickering faster and turning white-hot in your look's colours. The key fills up with a seconds counter so you can time it, and reads FULL when it's maxed out. Let go and it drops. Slide your finger off the key to cancel.

Pick a build style under the key (each phone or tablet remembers its own pick):

  • Rise: light climbs from the floor with a soft rainbow sweep (the classic).
  • Close in: a ring of light squeezes in from the edges to the middle.
  • Burst out: a glowing core grows from the middle out to the edges.
  • Spin: a radar sweep that speeds up and grows more arms.
  • Rainbow: a full, bright rainbow wash that gets faster.
  • Zipper: two bars race in from the sides and meet in the middle.
  • Heartbeat: a heart in the middle thumps faster and faster, rocking, sparkling and changing colours.
  • Star: a star spins up and grows, sparkling, with its colours racing faster.

Drop styles

Under the build styles, pick what the wall does the moment the drop lands:

  • Classic: the plain drop, a new effect and a colour change.
  • Supernova: a split second of black, then a blinding burst with sparks flying out.
  • Star burst: a giant spinning star races out to the edges.
  • Heart pop: a heart swells, then bursts into little hearts.
  • Shatter: the wall cracks like glass and the pieces fall away.
  • Color bomb: one colour slams the whole wall, then drips off.
  • Rainbow wave: a rainbow shockwave rolls across.
  • Bass slam: a hard white hit and the wall shakes on the bass.
  • Lightning: lightning strikes, then the new look flares in.

Both rows have the same three choices: One style, 🎲 My mix (tick the ones you like) and 🎲 Full random. Builds start on 🌀 Spin, drops start on Full random. Every build and every drop can be different, never the same one twice in a row.

Pro move: Blackout for one bar, then hold Build through the last bars of the build-up and let go right on the drop.

Hit pads

Thirteen big pads. Out of the box a pad fires the instant your finger touches it. Tap ⚡ Instant at the top of the card to switch to 🥁 Snap to beat: then every pad waits for the next beat, so even a late tap lands right on time.

  • 💥 Drop: a full drop move, with a new effect and a color change.
  • ⚡ Strobe: four beats of white strobe.
  • ⚪ Flash: one big white flash.
  • 🔥 Fire burst and 🎉 Confetti: a blast over the show for a couple of seconds.
  • ⬛ Blackout: holds the wall dark until you tap it again. Great right before a drop.
  • Sweep: a bright bar wipes across the wall.
  • Shockwave: a ring blasts out from the middle.
  • Color bomb: a flood of colour bursts from the centre.
  • Lightning: a forked bolt cracks down the wall.
  • 3-2-1: a big countdown on the beat, then a burst.
  • Heartbeat: a heart thumps twice in the middle, rocking and sparkling.
  • ⭐ Star: a colourful star pops in, spins and sparkles.

The new pads follow the music's beat and the look's colours.

Skip a look or an effect

Right under the pads are four skip keys:

  • ◀ Look and ▶ Next look step back or forward through the looks.
  • ◀ Effect and ▶ Next effect do the same for the effect on the wall right now.

A live Look and Effect readout underneath shows the names, so you always know what's playing without looking up at the wall. Went one too far? Tap ◀ to step straight back.

Tap tempo

Room too loud, or a song with no clear kick? Tap TAP four times or more on the beat and the whole show locks to your tapping. Back to automatic tempo hands the beat back to the music.

Cue the next look

Tap a look in Cue the next look. It waits, then comes in on the next drop, yours or the music's. Tap it again to clear the cue.

Crowd lines

Big words flashed across the wall for three seconds: HANDS UP, JUMP, MAKE SOME NOISE and more. Type your own, like your DJ name; GlowBop keeps your last six.

Record it into the song Pro DJ Turn on ● Record on the SHOWS page and every pad, build drop, crowd line and look you pick here lands on that song's timeline, snapped to the beat. A red bar on the DJ page shows while you record. See Song Shows.

DJ controllers

  1. Plug a USB DJ controller or MIDI pad into the laptop that runs GlowBop. GlowBop finds it in a couple of seconds.
  2. Tap Controllers & Sync on the DJ page (it opens the panel in SETUP). If GlowBop knows your controller, it offers a ready-made layout.
  3. Or teach it by hand: long-press (or right-click) any pad, Build or Tap, then hit the button on your controller.
Hit pads, Build and Tap work on every plan. Mapping the Pro tools, controller layouts with LED feedback, MIDI clock and VirtualDJ sync are in Pro DJ Pro DJ. The controller plugs into the laptop; your phone keeps working at the same time.

♫ Back to music under the wall clears a blackout, tap tempo or a cued look.

title: Pro DJ tools
sub: Autoloops, cue lists, tempo, Song Shows, LIVE BOARD, zones, override keys, MIDI and VirtualDJ.
html:
Pro DJ lighting for the lights you already own. Pro DJ is the same GlowBop app with a full lighting desk for gigs, weddings, clubs, churches and venues, on consumer LED lights instead of DMX stage fixtures. It listens to the audio, so it works with any DJ software; VirtualDJ and MIDI clock give the tightest sync. A Pro DJ key adds four tabs to the ★ Pro group of the rail: LOOPS & CUES, SHOWS, LIVE BOARD and OVERRIDE. In this guide the Pro tools carry a small Pro DJ tag. Want the big picture first? See the Pro DJ page.

🔁

Autoloops & Scenes

32 beat-synced looks, plus your own saved moments.
🎬

Cue lists

Plan the event, then one big GO per moment.
🥁

Tempo toolbox

Fine BPM, x2, /2, nudge, lock and Auto Ambient.
🎞️

Song Shows

Program a whole song on a timeline.
🎚️

LIVE BOARD

Faders, zone faders, palettes and the Pad Recorder.
⛔

Override keys

Take over the wall (or one zone) in one touch.
☕

Interlude · Ambient

A calm wall for talking breaks.
🎛️

MIDI & VirtualDJ

Controllers, MIDI clock and VirtualDJ sync.
🕹️

Try it now

Every Pro tool, live in your browser.

Unlock Pro DJ

  1. Pick a Pro DJ plan on the pricing page. Your key starts with GBPRO-.
  2. In the console, tap SETUP → License and paste the key. Or tap I have a Pro key on the PRO tour.
  3. The Pro tabs appear on the rail right away. No reinstall and no new hardware: the same lights and the same laptop.
On Home DJ, the Pro group of the rail is a single gold PRO key: a tour of every Pro tool with a little preview of each. Want to play first? The live demo is the real console on a pretend wall, and the Pro tools work there.

🔁 Autoloops Pro DJ

Tap LOOPS & CUES. Autoloops are 32 ready-made, beat-synced looks in four banks: A · Club, B · Chill / Flow, C · Big Room and D · Color, eight pads each, plus a fifth bank, My scenes. Each pad is a look, one or two effects and a colour palette, locked to the beat.

  • Tap a pad and it drops in on the next bar and holds the wall until you change it. Turn on Snap to switch at once instead.
  • ◀ Prev Next ▶ step through the bank. Release hands the wall back to the auto show.
  • Repeat keeps the pad going. Advance moves to the next pad every 4, 8, 16 or 32 bars.
  • Each pad can run at ¼, ½, 1, 2 or 4 times the beat, and you pick the fade for each change.

🎞️ Scenes

Love how the wall looks right now? In the My scenes bank tap Save scene: GlowBop keeps the look, the effect, the colours and the faders. Tap the scene later and it comes back with a smooth fade. Manage scenes renames, reorders and deletes them.

🎬 Cue lists with a big GO Pro DJ

Use the switch at the top of LOOPS & CUES to open Cues. Plan the event top to bottom as a list of cues, then tap GO for each moment. Each cue crossfades in over its fade time.

  • A cue can be an Autoloop, one of your Scenes, a Blackout, an Interlude or Back to Auto, each with a fade and a note like "First dance".
  • The page shows what is on now and what comes next, in big letters. Back goes one cue back, and you can jump to any cue.
  • Keep a list per event: a wedding, a Sunday service, a school dance.
  • On a laptop, the space bar is GO and Shift + space goes back.
Wedding example: 1 Grand entrance (Arena Beams, 2 s fade) · 2 First dance (Nebula Hush, 4 s) · 3 Cake cutting (your Golden hour scene) · 4 Dance floor opens (Neon Rain) · 5 Last song · 6 Back to Auto. The demo comes with this list ready to GO.

🥁 Tempo toolbox and Auto Ambient Pro DJ

Also on LOOPS & CUES. Make every flash land exactly on the kick:

  • Fine-tune the BPM in 0.1 and 1 BPM steps, then Lock it.
  • x2 and /2 for double or half time.
  • Nudge the beat a little earlier or later until it sits right.
  • Auto Ambient goes calm by itself when the music stops for 5, 10, 20 or 45 seconds, and comes back with the music.

🎞️ Song Shows Pro DJ

Build a light show for a song once and it plays the same way every time that song comes on, right on the beat. Anywhere your show is empty, GlowBop keeps reacting live. Tap SHOWS in the Pro group.

The timeline

Pick a song from the list. Every song GlowBop has heard shows up there, with its tempo and how many drops it has. The timeline has a bar ruler, the song's sections in color, the drops marked in pink, and six lanes:

  • Look: which look plays from here.
  • Hits: any of the 12 hit pads, including blackouts.
  • Color: lock one to three colors in place of the look's own.
  • Brightness: a curve you draw, from 0 to 100 percent.
  • Text: words on the wall, like a crowd line.
  • FX: lock one effect for a stretch of the song.

Tap an empty spot in a lane to add a cue there, or tap a lane's name to add one at the playhead. Drag a cue to move it, drag its right edge to stretch it, tap it to change it. Everything snaps to the beat. Pinch or use − + to zoom, and turn on Follow to keep the playhead in view. It saves by itself, and Undo is one tap away.

Auto-draft

Tap ✨ Auto-draft and GlowBop writes a first show from what it already knows about the song: the tempo, the bar grid, the drops it remembers, the mood and the key. Builds lead into the drops, and the biggest drop gets the biggest moment. Then drag, stretch and tweak it until it's yours.

Record your DJ pads into the song

Tap ● Record on the SHOWS page, then play the song and go to DJ. Every pad, build drop, crowd line and look you pick lands on that song's timeline at that moment, snapped to the beat. A red bar on the DJ page shows while you record; tap Stop when you're done.

How it follows the song

A show plays when GlowBop knows where in the song it is:

  • Exact with GlowBop's own player, and with music apps that share their timeline with Windows, like Spotify or Apple Music, when they report it.
  • Kept on the beat for other apps when GlowBop caught the song from its start: it counts from there and locks to the song's remembered bar grid.
  • If it can't tell, the live show runs and the SHOWS page says why.

♫ Back to music under the wall skips the show for the rest of this play. It comes back next time the song plays. To keep a song's show for later without playing it, turn off Play this song's show on its timeline. Song Shows: off turns them all off at once.

🎚️ LIVE BOARD: the fader board Pro DJ

Tap LIVE BOARD. Six live faders sit at the top and ride on top of whatever is playing.

  • Master: brightness for the whole wall.
  • Speed: slows the animation down to a quarter, or speeds it up to three times.
  • Strobe: off at the bottom, then locked to the beat as you push up: every beat, 1/2, 1/4 and 1/8.
  • Color: a color wheel that tints the show.
  • White: blends the wall toward white.
  • Trails: leaves glowing trails behind moving light.

Drag anywhere on a fader, up or down. It moves from where it already is, so a stray touch never makes the lights jump. On an iPad, two fingers move two faders at once. Double-tap a fader to reset it, or tap ↺ Reset all.

Hold keys

Under each fader is a key that works while your finger is down: ⬛ Blackout, ⏩ 2X double time, ⚡ Full strobe, 🌈 Rainbow, ⚪ White and ❄️ Freeze.

Every phone, iPad and the laptop show the same fader positions. When a fader is away from normal, a 🎚️ FADERS chip shows in the mode bar; tap it to jump back to the board.

Auto-release safety: while your finger is down, a hold key keeps checking in. If the Wi-Fi drops or the phone locks, the key lets go by itself about a second later, so the wall never gets stuck in a blackout or a strobe.

🧩 Zones and zone faders (submasters)

Split the wall into zones: left, right, top, bottom, center, odd and even, each curtain, and every named string from Draw your layout. On the LIVE BOARD each zone gets its own fader, like a submaster. On OVERRIDE, Override target aims the override keys at one zone.

🎨 Colour palettes

Pick a palette on the LIVE BOARD (Neon Club, Sunset, Ice, Forest, Candy, Gold & White, Blush, Stars & Stripes) or make your own from the colour wheel. Every look, Autoloop and auto show switches to those colours until you clear it. Perfect for wedding or brand colours.

⏺️ Pad Recorder

A sampler for your lights, at the bottom of the LIVE BOARD: four banks, A to D, with four slots each. (It used to be called Loop banks.)

  • Play: tap a slot and it starts on the next bar, looping on the beat over any song. Tap again and it stops at the end of the bar (or set Stop a loop to At once). One loop per bank plays at a time, and the banks play together.
  • Starter loops: eight are ready to go: Four on the floor, Offbeat strobe, Build riser, Drop hits, Color chase, Flash roll, Blackout chops, and Fire and confetti.
  • Record: tap 🔴 Record, pick 1, 2, 4 or 8 bars, then tap a slot. Recording starts on the next bar and catches the hit pads you play, on a 1/4 or 1/8 beat grid. Record into a playing slot to add one more layer.
  • Edit: tap ✏️ Edit, then a slot, to rename it, change its length and tap hits on or off in a 16-step grid for each bar. You can nudge, copy and clear too.
  • A 🔁 LOOPS chip in the mode bar shows while loops play; one tap stops them all. On the laptop, L stops every loop.

⛔ Override keys Pro DJ

Tap OVERRIDE. Eight big keys take over the whole wall at once (or just the zone in Override target), whatever is playing, and hand it back when you let go.

  • Flash keys are on while your finger is down. Latch keys stay on until you tap them again. House starts as a latch key, the rest as flash keys.
  • Disco drops a spinning disco ball onto the wall. Audience sweeps bright beams over the crowd.
  • Hold several at once and the strongest wins: Blackout, then White, Strobe, Disco, House, the colors and Audience. Strobe flashes in the color of a held color key.
  • Tap ✏️ Edit keys, then a key, to set flash or latch, its fade (snap, a quarter second or one second), its color and its name.
  • On the laptop, keys 1 to 8 work from any page (not while you're typing) and 0 releases everything.
  • While any override is on, an ⛔ OVERRIDE ACTIVE chip shows in the mode bar on every screen. Tap it, or ✋ Release all, to let them all go.
Held override keys have the same auto-release safety as the fader hold keys: lose the Wi-Fi and they let go by themselves.

☕ Interlude · Ambient Pro DJ

For talking breaks, speeches and band changeovers. It sits under the override keys on OVERRIDE. Tap 🎙️ Start interlude and the wall goes calm and stops following the music, so a mic or silence can't make it twitch.

  • Interlude look: 🌬️ Breathing, 🔤 Words drifting slowly over a soft glow (BE RIGHT BACK, or type your own, like the event name), 🕯️ Warm glow, or 🎨 A look, slowed.
  • Coming back: a plain fade, or a fade with a flash or a drop.
  • Auto Ambient: pick 5, 10, 20 or 45 seconds and silence starts an interlude by itself. When the music comes back, so does the show.
  • The mode bar button turns into 🎵 Back to the show. On the laptop, press I.
  • Song Show cues wait during an interlude, then pick up where the song is.

🎛️ MIDI controllers

Plug a USB DJ controller or pad into the laptop that runs GlowBop. It shows up in SETUP → Controllers & Sync in a couple of seconds.

  • Learn any control: long-press (or right-click) any pad, fader, override key, Autoloop or cue key in the console, then press a button or move a fader on your controller.
  • Ready layouts for the Akai APC mini mk2 and APC40 mkII, Novation Launchpad Mini MK3, Launchpad X and Launch Control XL, plus a generic 8 pads + 8 knobs layout. Pick one under Controller layout and tap Use.
  • LED feedback: the pads on your controller light up to match what is on.
  • Soft takeover: a fader only moves a value once it reaches it, so nothing jumps.
Hit pads, Build and Tap work on Home DJ too. Mapping the Pro tools, MIDI clock and VirtualDJ sync are Pro DJ.

MIDI clock in and out Pro DJ

Under Beat from, pick MIDI clock to follow the clock from your DJ software or a drum machine. Send MIDI clock out sends GlowBop's beat to other gear. If the clock stops, GlowBop goes back to listening to the audio.

VirtualDJ link Pro DJ

GlowBop can follow VirtualDJ's beat directly over OS2L:

  1. In VirtualDJ, open Settings → Options and search for os2l.
  2. Set os2lDirectIp to 127.0.0.1:9996 (VirtualDJ on another computer: use the GlowBop laptop's address instead of 127.0.0.1).
  3. Restart VirtualDJ, then in GlowBop pick VirtualDJ under Beat from.
GlowBop listens to the audio, so it works with any DJ software: Serato, rekordbox, Traktor, djay and more. The deeper sync comes from MIDI clock and the VirtualDJ link. Ableton Link, Pro DJ Link and StageLinQ are not supported.

"Test my controller"

Something not mapping right? In Controllers & Sync tap Test my controller: press pads and move faders and every message shows with what it does in GlowBop. Tap Send to GlowBop support and the test goes straight to us, so we can add or fix your controller.

title: Looks, effects & games
sub: Looks, calm and genre styles, the flow pack, scenes, pinning, games and transitions.
html:
What a look is

A look is a mood: a color palette plus a set of effects for calm, medium and loud moments. During a song GlowBop picks effects from the current look, and moves to a new look at drops or when the song changes.

All 45 looks

Tap LOOKS, then any look to jump to it. Turn on Pin to keep it, or tap Release in the mode bar to hand control back to GlowBop.

🌙 Calm pack: soft when the song is soft

Not every song wants strobes. Movie scores, chill songs and jazz stay calm and flowing, with 12 calm effects (aurora veils, cathedral rays, sky lanterns, piano keys, bowed strings, moonlit snow and more) and four calm looks: Cinematic, Concert Hall, Jazz Club and Moonlit.

GlowBop picks this by itself. To tell it, use the Jazz, Chill or Epic light style on MUSIC. See Light styles.

🎸 Genre looks

When song lookup knows the genre, Auto gives each kind of music its own look, with no extra buttons:

  • Rock: Rock Arena. Hip-hop: Velvet Bounce. Latin and Afrobeats: Tropicana.
  • Country and folk: Golden Porch. Kids songs: Toy Box.
  • Christmas and Halloween songs switch to the holiday show, in season.

The MUSIC page shows the guess, like Auto · Rock.

🌊 Flow pack

Melodic bass, progressive and chillstep get the Flow style with two looks, Trip and Silk, and 14 flowy effects: silk and ribbons, liquid and ink, waves and tides, and particle flocks like a murmuration of birds. Each one has a dreamy mood for the verses and a bigger drop mood when the song lands.

👁️ Eyeball and spin

Now and then a giant eye peeks in, looks around and blinks. Don't want it? Turn off Eyeball in Show control on MUSIC. Spinning effects now turn both left and right, so the wall feels less repetitive.

3D, club, nature and retro looks

  • 3D Depth: tunnels, spinning cubes, disco spheres and black holes that look like they go deep into the wall.
  • Club Rig: moving-head beams, laser scans and strobe banks, like a real club ceiling.
  • Dance Crew: pixel characters that dance to the beat. Turn them on or off with Characters.
  • Retro Arcade: the self-playing pixel games now live under their own GAMES key (below).
  • Wild Elements: rain on the window, a volcano that erupts on the drop, a tornado, a waterfall and the surface of the sun.

Big Wave 🌊

The newest family of effects, with its own Big Wave look. They also turn up in Molten, Neon Party and Storm & Sea.

  • Big Wave: a giant glowing wave that rolls and crests on the beat.
  • Serpent: a smooth snake with a glowing head that swims the length of your wall.
  • Twin Waves: two waves crossing, with sparkles on the crest.
  • Ocean Swell: a slow, deep swell for calm songs.

See the looks and the newest effects in the gallery →

Arcade games 🕹️

The self-playing games have their own key, GAMES. Tap a game and it plays on the wall, speeding up with the music:

  • Breakout, Snake, Pong, Alien parade, Space rocks, Block drop, Light cycles and Game of life.
  • 🕹️ Arcade marathon plays every game in turn.
  • Tap the playing game (or the marathon) again to turn it off. ♫ Back to music under the wall ends it too.

Quick scenes and Describe a scene

Under SCENES (below the fireplace), Quick scenes are one-tap presets. Describe a scene lets you type what you want ("slow purple ocean with gold sparkles") and tap Play it. GlowBop picks matching effects and colors from your words.

Feature an effect

Love one effect? Feature it for the current part of the song, or Pin it to keep it on. Tap Let the show flow again to go back to normal.

Transitions

Choose how one effect hands over to the next: quick cuts for high-energy sets, long fades for a chill night.

title: Holidays & mini-movies
sub: Holidays for your country and the animated stories.
html:
Holidays have their own section, HOLIDAY, so they don't pop up in the middle of a July pool party. Tap a holiday and the wall plays only that holiday until you stop it.

Holidays for your country

GlowBop shows the holidays of the country you live in, with the right dates and local names, worked out on your computer. It picks the country from your location on the LIVE tab, or choose one at the top of HOLIDAY. More holidays from other countries shows the rest of the 23. When one of your holidays is on or within 10 days, the HOLIDAY key moves up the rail next to LOOKS.

The holidays

🎃

Halloween

Jack-o'-lanterns, bat swarms, ghosts, a haunted house, and the Halloween Night mini-movie.

🎄

Christmas

A twinkling tree, candy canes, a sleigh ride, snow, and the Christmas Eve mini-movie.

🎆

New Year

Fireworks, sparklers and a ball drop.

❤️

Valentine's

Floating hearts and warm pinks.

☘️

St. Patrick's

Greens and gold.

🦃

Thanksgiving

Autumn colors.

🎂

Birthday

Confetti cannons and cake. Add the name with Text.

🏈

Game Day

Waving flags and team-color energy.

🎇

4th of July

Fireworks in red, white and blue.

New from around the world

14 more holiday shows, picked by your country:

South of the equator, snowy winter effects stay out of summer holidays.

Holiday songs

Play a Christmas song from mid-November to early January, or a Halloween song in October, and the music show switches to that holiday's show by itself. Out of season, the song gets the normal show.

Mini-movies

For the four biggest nights, GlowBop plays a short animated story in chapters, drawn as crisp pixel art. They're wide-screen: on 2, 3 or 4 curtains the scene stretches across the whole wall (the witch flies the full length, the sleigh crosses every curtain).

  • 🎃 Halloween Night: fog, a graveyard, a witch across the moon, haunted houses, bats, ghosts, screaming jack-o'-lanterns on the drop, a lightning storm.
  • 🦃 Harvest Day: sunset on the farm, falling leaves, a strutting turkey, the harvest moon, dinner by candlelight, a whirlwind of leaves on the drop.
  • 🎄 Christmas Eve: snow on the village, windows lighting up, a giant tree filling with ornaments, Santa's sleigh, presents bursting into fireworks.
  • 🎆 New Year Countdown: the city skyline, confetti, a 10-to-1 countdown as the ball drops, fireworks at midnight, a champagne toast.

Choose the effects

Inside each holiday you can toggle which effects are in the rotation, so you can keep the ones your family loves.

Trick-or-treat tip: start Halloween at dusk, set Pace to Chill, and the mini-movie plays every few switches between the spooky effects.

title: Fireplace
sub: Nine fire styles, nine colors, cozy or roaring, flare on the beat.
html:
Turn the whole wall into a fire with one tap. There's no fireplace frame and no logs, just the flames, simulated live so they never loop.

Light the fire

  1. Tap SCENES on the side rail. The Fireplace is at the top of the page.
  2. Tap Light the fire. The mode bar turns orange and says FIREPLACE 🔥.
  3. To stop, tap Put out fire, or ♫ Back to music under the live wall from any section.

9 fire styles

  • 🔥 Fireplace: the classic: tall flames with a white-hot core and floating embers.
  • 🏕️ Campfire: crossed logs, glowing coals and a cone of flame. Wide walls get two.
  • 🎇 Bonfire: a huge blaze that roars up on the drop.
  • 🕯️ Candle wall: rows of candles, each flickering on its own.
  • 🔦 Torch row: torches on a brick wall lit by their own flicker.
  • 👾 Pixel flames: chunky 8-bit cartoon fire.
  • 👻 Spirit fire: slow, ghostly blue flames with curling wisps.
  • 🌋 Lava rising: molten lava with popping bubbles, rising and falling.
  • 🐉 Dragon breath: embers, then a jet of fire blasts across the wall.

9 colors

Team colors lets you pick any two colors (great for game day). Night shift slowly drifts from classic to purple, blue and green over the night.

Rainbow drifts slowly through every color across the wall and keeps a white-hot core. Green is great for Halloween and St. Patrick's, Pink for Valentine's, Ice for a ghostly winter look.

Cozy or Roaring

  • 🛋️ Cozy: tall, relaxing flames that reach up the wall, with a small flare now and then.
  • 🔥 Roaring: fast, wild flicker with big whooshes of flame every few seconds and bursts of sparks.

Calm, Dance or Flare on the beat

  • 🕯️ Calm: the fire ignores the music. Perfect for a quiet night.
  • 💃 Dance: the flames swell gently with the beat. Fire that grooves.
  • Flare on the beat: every kick sends the flames up with a burst of sparks, and when the music is loud, gusts of wind sweep through the fire.

On a big wall

With several curtains, GlowBop builds one long bed of fire across all of them, like a modern linear fireplace. Stacked curtains get taller flames.

Good to know: the fireplace stays lit until you put it out. The fire, the scoreboard and live feeds take turns: turning one on turns the others off. Text and logos still show on top of the flames.

title: Sports
sub: Game Day, Live Fan in 44 leagues, F1, golf, racing, tennis, UFC and the countdown clock.
html:
Tap SPORTS on the side rail and pick a mode: Game Day, Live Fan or F1. Golf, racing, tennis and UFC are in the Live Fan league list. Off returns to the light show.

Game Day: keep score yourself

  1. Choose a Sport from the dropdown: Soccer, Football, Basketball, Baseball, Softball, Hockey, Field hockey, Lacrosse, Volleyball, Pickleball, Tennis, Rugby, Aussie rules, Cricket, Water polo, Cornhole, Other, plus a Countdown timer.
  2. Open ⚙️ Game setup to set minutes per period, number of periods, and ⏳ Count down or ⏱️ Count up. Tap Set up the game.
  3. Tap ▶ Start to run the clock. Nudge it with −1 min −10 s +10 s +1 min.
  4. Add points with the score buttons, or type the score straight into the box. −1 fixes a mistake.

Timeouts, fouls and the ball

  • Use − and + for timeouts and fouls. They show as dots on the wall.
  • Tap the ball button to switch possession.
  • Baseball and softball track balls, strikes and outs. Football tracks down and distance.
  • Use the arrows to change period, quarter or half.

Fix-it buttons

  • ↶ Undo takes back the last change (up to 40 steps).
  • ⇄ Swap sides flips the teams at halftime.
  • New game clears everything (it asks first).

Every score gets a celebration on the wall, and it doesn't always say "GOAL". Expect SCORE, TOUCHDOWN, a big burst of color and more.

At the field: bring the laptop, turn on your phone hotspot, connect the laptop to it, then open the remote link on your phone. Battery-powered curtains make this easy.

Live Fan: follow a real game

  1. Tap Live Fan, pick a League, then your Team. There are 44 leagues in five groups:
    • 🇺🇸 Pro: NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, UFL, CFL, Premier Lacrosse League, USL Championship.
    • 👩 Women: WNBA, NWSL, England Women's Super League, Women's Champions League, Women's World Cup.
    • 🎓 College: football, men's and women's basketball, baseball, softball, men's and women's hockey, men's and women's volleyball, men's and women's lacrosse, field hockey.
    • 🌍 World soccer: Premier League, EFL Championship, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1, Eredivisie, Primeira Liga, Liga MX, Saudi Pro League, Champions League, Europa League, Copa Libertadores, World Cup.
    • 🌏 More of the world: AFL (Aussie rules), Rugby World Cup, FIBA Basketball World Cup, Indian Premier League cricket.
  2. Tap Follow this team.
  3. During the game the score updates every 10 seconds. When your team scores, the wall celebrates in their colors.

Live stats and the Game Center

  • Game Center on your phone: the linescore inning by inning (or by quarter), hits and errors, the leaders, the series and each team's record.
  • Baseball: balls, strikes and outs, runners on base, who's batting and pitching, top or bottom of the inning. Every 16 seconds the wall shows a little diamond with the runners and the count.
  • Football: down and distance, ball on, who has it, and a red-zone alert.
  • The last play scrolls across the wall each time something happens.
GlowBop uses public score feeds and has backups for the major leagues. If a feed is slow, the board catches up on the next update.

F1 live board 🏎️

  • Rows show position and driver code with a team color tab.
  • A tyre dot: red soft, yellow medium, white hard.
  • A flashing DRS attack bar grows under a driver closing inside one second.
  • Purple for the fastest lap holder, a flashing yellow flag stripe for the safety car, red for a red flag, a chequered stripe at the finish, and rain falling on the wall when it's wet.
  • Celebrations in the driver's team colors for NEW LEADER, POLE, TOP TIME, WINNER, FASTEST LAP and SAFETY CAR. Pit stops get a soft flash with the stop time.

Works during practice, qualifying and the race, whenever a session is live.

⛳ Golf, 🏁 Racing, 🎾 Tennis and 🥊 UFC

Tap Live Fan, open the League list and pick ⛳ Golf, 🏁 Racing, 🎾 Tennis or 🥊 UFC at the bottom, then tap Put it on the wall. Its settings (favorite player, series and so on) open right below.

  • Golf: the tournament leaderboard. Under par shows red like on TV, over par blue. Pick a favorite player and they always get a glowing spot on the wall. A new leader sets off a celebration.
  • Racing: NASCAR Cup, O'Reilly and Truck series, and IndyCar. The running order with each car in its own color and the flag on top: green, caution, red, white for the last lap, checkered at the finish.
  • Tennis: ATP and WTA singles. Each match shows both players, the games in every set, the current set glowing yellow and a ball dot by the server. Pick a favorite and they always get a spot; a set or match win sets off a celebration.
  • UFC: the card for the next or current event, red corner over blue. Live fights show the round and clock, finished ones the result (KO, SUB, DEC), and every finish sets off a celebration in the winner's color.

All of them show the next event's start time when nothing is live.

Countdown timer

Pick Countdown timer only as the sport for a giant clock across the whole wall: halftime, a party countdown, New Year's Eve.

title: Live feeds
sub: Countdowns, weather, storms, overhead, quakes, aurora, launches, moon, globe, volcanoes and fires.
html:
Live feeds bring the outside world onto your lights. Tap LIVE, then a big key to put that feed on the wall. Tap it again, or ♫ Back to music under the wall, to go back to the music show.

Set your location once

Weather, storm watch, overhead, quakes, launches, fires and sun times need to know where you are. In LIVE → Live feeds, type a ZIP code or City, State and tap Save. GlowBop shows the place it found underneath.

Tap a feed key again to turn it off. Every new feed has a preview button, so you can see what it looks like before the real thing happens.

🎉 Countdown

  • Pick a ready-made countdown: New Year's, Christmas, Halloween or the 4th of July. They always point at the next one.
  • Or add your own: a name, a date and time, and a finale message like HAPPY BIRTHDAY.
  • Choose a color. The wall shows days, then hours, minutes and seconds. The last minute is giant pulsing seconds, then fireworks and your message.
  • Preview the finale shows the ending right now, so you know what to expect.

🌦️ Weather

A big temperature over an animated pixel sky: sun and rays, clouds, rain, thunderstorms, snow, fog, and the moon and stars at night. It flips between Now, Today (high and low) and Next hours. Pick °F, °C or Auto. It checks for new weather every 10 minutes.

🌀 Storm watch

Storm watch is different: it runs quietly on top of the music show, and only if you turn it on. When the National Weather Service puts out a new warning, watch or advisory for your spot, the wall flashes and the alert name scrolls by. A warning keeps a thin red edge glowing until it ends. During hurricane season it also lists named storms and how far away they are.

  • Test alert shows what an alert looks like. While it's on the wall the key turns into Stop the alert, and ♫ Back to music under the wall clears it too.

🌍 Storm warnings worldwide

Outside the US, Storm watch worldwide on the LIVE page picks a source for your country: GDACS tropical cyclones and floods everywhere, MeteoAlarm official warnings in 38 European countries, or any national CAP alert feed you paste in.

Not an official warning system. Always follow official alerts, your phone's emergency alerts and local officials.

✈️ Overhead now

A radar of the planes flying over your house right now, with their direction, plus the International Space Station when it comes by. Choose how far out to look. When the space station is as close as it gets, the wall celebrates. Wave hi! 👋

🌍 Earthquakes

Recent earthquakes drop onto a world map or a spinning globe with a ripple, the biggest first, with how far away they are. Pick the smallest size to show (2.5, 4.5 or 6). Turn on Alert over music and a big one flashes over the music show too.

🌌 Aurora

Slow aurora curtains that follow the live space weather: the higher the Kp index (0 to 9), the taller, brighter and more colourful they get. A solar flare sends a soft gold flash. GlowBop also tells you roughly what Kp it takes to see the aurora from where you live.

🚀 Rocket launches

The next rocket launches around the world, with a countdown on the wall and liftoff when it goes. Turn on Alert over music for a liftoff flash over the show.

🌕 Moon & sun

Tonight's moon phase, how full it is and the next full moon, plus sunrise, sunset and golden hour for your spot. Worked out on your computer, no internet needed.

🌐 Globe

The Earth spinning on your wall, day and night, with the day's quakes, storms, volcanoes, fires and launches marked on it. Let it spin, or keep your home in view.

🌋 Volcanoes

Volcanoes with an alert right now, with an eruption on the wall and how far away they are.

🔥 Wildfires

Big wildfires near you, and with your own free NASA FIRMS key the hotspots seen from space around you. Get a key at firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov and paste it on the LIVE page. Each customer uses their own key.

Data credits

Earthquakes: USGS. Space weather: NOAA SWPC. Rocket launches: The Space Devs. Cyclones, floods, volcanoes and wildfires: Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System, GDACS. European warnings: EUMETNET MeteoAlarm. Fire hotspots: NASA FIRMS. Weather alerts in the US: National Weather Service.

title: Text, logos & mirror
sub: Messages, logos and mirroring your screen.
html:
Text on the wall

  1. Tap TEXT and type your message.
  2. Pick a Mode: Scroll (marquee), Beat words (one word per beat), Still, or On drop (shows on each drop).
  3. Pick a Color: Look (follows the show), Rainbow or White.
  4. Pick a Layer: Over the show or Text only. Set the speed, then tap Show text.
Flash a word on every drop: type one big word like the birthday kid's name or "JUMP" and it hits the wall each time the beat drops.

Your logo

  1. Under Logo, tap Choose a picture. A PNG with a see-through or black background works best.
  2. Pick a Motion: Glow, Pulse or Colour shift.
  3. Tap Show logo, or Text + logo for both.

Great for DJs, bars, gyms and businesses. Save it and it's ready next time.

Slideshow: turn it on and, while the logo is on the wall, it rotates through every saved logo, including the built-in GlowBop logos.

Saved messages and logos

  • Tap Save under the text or the logo to keep it. It appears as a chip at the bottom of the card.
  • Tap a saved chip to put it back on the wall.
  • To delete one, tap the ✕ next to it. It turns red and asks Delete?. Tap again to delete.
  • 🗑️ Remove logo from the wall clears the picture that's loaded right now (your saved copy stays).

Screen mirror

Show the laptop screen on the lights: a game, a movie, a music video. It's under SCENES, or tap Mirror under the live wall.

  • Style: TV (the picture), Beat (the picture pulsing to the music), Glow (soft ambient color).
  • Area: Smart fill trims black bars so the video fills the wall; Center zoom shows bigger shapes.
Mirror works best with the video playing full screen on the laptop.

title: Light groups
sub: Run different shows on different lights.
html:
By default all your lights are one wall running one show. Groups let you split them: one show on the curtains, another on the tree, for example.

Make groups

  1. Tap LIGHTS and find Light groups.
  2. Choose All together (one big wall) or Each separate.
  3. In Layout & shape just below, pick One canvas to stretch shows across lights, or Zones to give each light its own area.
  4. Tap Apply & restart lights.

Control a group

With two or more groups, a row of chips appears above the live wall: All groups plus one chip per group. Tap a chip and every button controls only that group. The live preview shows all groups side by side; tap one there to select it.

title: Troubleshooting
html:
My phone says "Your lights are taking a breather"

That screen means your phone can't reach the GlowBop laptop right now. Check the three things it lists: the same Wi-Fi, the laptop awake, and GlowBop open on the laptop. It reconnects by itself as soon as the laptop answers, or tap Try again now.

The console won't open on my phone

  • Phone and computer must be on the same Wi-Fi. Not the guest network, and not cellular.
  • Turn off any VPN on the phone.
  • In Windows, allow GlowBop on private networks (Windows Security → Firewall → Allow an app).
  • Make sure your Wi-Fi is set to Private in Windows, not Public.

GlowBop can't find my lights

  • Check the curtain shows up and works in its own app first.
  • Restart the curtain (unplug for 10 seconds) and tap Find my lights again on the LIGHTS tab.
  • Use Add by brand if it still hides.
  • Bluetooth lights: close the light's own phone app (they take one connection at a time), keep them within about 30 feet of the computer, and make sure Bluetooth is on in Windows.

The lights don't react to music

  • The music must play on the computer GlowBop runs on. Check the sound is actually coming out (volume up, right speaker selected).
  • The mode bar should say MUSIC SHOW · LISTENING. If something else has taken over (a holiday, the fire, a live feed), tap ♫ Back to music.

The lights are early or late

Use the Sync slider. Bluetooth speakers usually need it slid right. See Sync.

A curtain is upside down or out of order

Run the line-up wizard again, fix it, and lock it in.

Lights flicker or stutter

  • Move the router closer, or the curtain's controller closer to the router.
  • Close heavy programs on the laptop and plug it into power.

My phone keeps going to the lock screen

Tap the console once after it opens: the screen then stays on. Check SETUP → Screen says Screen stays on.

Something is stuck or acting up

Open SETUP → Something not working? and tap 🔄 Restart GlowBop twice. It restarts the laptop app from your phone in about 10 seconds and your song picks up where it left off. 📱 Reload this screen refreshes just the phone or iPad.

The wall is stuck dark, white or strobing

  • Look at the mode bar. If ⛔ OVERRIDE ACTIVE shows, tap it to release the override keys. A 🎚️ FADERS chip means a fader is away from normal: tap it, then ↺ Reset all.
  • On the DJ page, the ⬛ Blackout pad holds the wall dark until you tap it again. Check Power at the top of the page too.
  • Pro DJ: a cue blackout or an Autoloop holds the wall. ♫ Back to music lets them all go.
  • In an interlude, tap 🎵 Back to the show. Anything else: ♫ Back to music.

My Song Show didn't play Pro DJ

A show only plays when GlowBop knows where in the song it is. Play the song on GlowBop's own player or a music app that shares its timeline with Windows, or start the song from the beginning. Check Song Shows is on and Play this song's show is on for that song. The SHOWS page tells you why when it can't play. See How it follows the song.

Live scores aren't updating

Scores only change while a game is live. Before kickoff the board shows the start time. Check the computer is online.

Still stuck? Tap Help & feedback at the bottom of the console to send us a report, or email hello@glowbop.com with what you see and your light brand.

title: All the features
sub: Everything GlowBop can do, in plain words.
html:
A quick tour of everything GlowBop can do, without the step-by-step detail. Tap any 📖 link for the how-to.

Phone & iPad remote · Music show · The console · Looks · DJ mode · Calm & genres · Holidays · Draw your layout · Live feeds · Scoreboard · Text & logos · Fireplace · Flow pack · Multi-curtain · Epic mode · Big Wave · Live science · 3D shapes · Games · Wild Elements · Formula 1 · Screen mirror · xLights houses

Phone & iPad remote

Control it all from your phone or iPad

The GlowBop laptop app shows a QR code. Scan it on any phone or tablet on the same Wi-Fi and the full console opens in the browser.

  • Live preview of every curtain right on your phone.
  • Big keys sized for thumbs on every section.
  • Add it to your home screen and it opens like an app, with its own icon.
  • Works at the field too, over your phone's hotspot.

📖 Phone setup

Music show

Hears the music, follows the song

GlowBop listens to the sound your computer is playing, so it works with any app: Spotify, YouTube, Apple Music, Serato, a playlist on a USB stick.

  • Beat, bass and melody each drive different parts of the show.
  • Build-ups and drops get their own moves.
  • Pace Chill, Normal or Hype, and Sparkles Off, Auto or Lots.
  • Sync slider lines the lights up with Bluetooth speakers that run late.
  • Song memory remembers how each song went the next time it plays.

📖 Music show guide

The console

A light-show console in your pocket

GlowBop has a brand-new control panel. A colored side rail jumps between sections, the live wall shows exactly what your lights are doing, and big keys sized for thumbs run the show.

  • A rail in four groups. Perform: Music and DJ. Visuals: Looks, Scenes (with the fireplace), Live, Sports, Text, Holiday and Games. ★ Pro: Loops & Cues, Shows, Live Board and Override. System: Lights and Setup. On Home DJ, one gold PRO key shows a tour of the Pro tools instead.
  • Power and Brightness keys at the top of every page.
  • LIGHTS holds everything about your lights: find them, groups, layout and shape, draw your layout, line up curtains and map with a camera. SETUP keeps the license, the remote QR code, controllers, text size, sounds and a restart key.
  • Live wall mirrors your lights in real time. Tap Full view for the whole screen.
  • iPad sideways becomes a two-column board: wall on the left, controls on the right.
  • Console sounds in 12 styles with a mute key, a screen-stays-on switch, and a friendly screen if the laptop goes out of reach.

📖 Console guide

Looks

45 looks, 300+ effects

A look is a mood: its colors plus a set of effects for calm, medium and loud parts. GlowBop shuffles through them as the music changes.

  • Neon Party, Deep Space, Synthwave, Warehouse Rave, Mainstage, Club Rig, Royal Gold and more.
  • 3D Depth tunnels, spinning cubes and disco spheres.
  • Dance Crew pixel characters you can switch on or off, and an Eyeball switch for the eye that peeks in now and then.
  • Spin both ways: spinning effects now turn left as well as right, so the wall feels less repetitive.
  • Describe a scene in words and GlowBop builds it.
  • Pin an effect you love, or hit Surprise me.

📖 Looks guide

DJ mode

Play the lights like a club lighting tech

DJ has its own key on the rail. The music show keeps running, and you add moves on top, by hand. Pads fire the instant you touch them, or turn on Snap to beat so every hit lands on the next beat.

  • 13 hit pads: Drop, Strobe, Flash, Fire burst, Confetti, and new Sweep, Shockwave, Color bomb, Lightning, 3-2-1 and Heartbeat. Blackout holds the wall dark.
  • Skip keys: ◀ Look ▶ Next look ◀ Effect ▶ Next effect, with a live Look and Effect readout under them.
  • Hold to build: the wall winds up brighter and faster; let go and it drops.
  • Cue the next look to come in on the next drop.
  • Tap tempo when the room is too loud, and crowd lines like HANDS UP in big letters.
  • DJ controller: plug a USB pad controller into the laptop, pick a ready-made layout or long-press any pad to teach it a button.
  • Pro DJ adds 📖 Autoloops, 📖 cue lists and the 📖 LIVE BOARD with faders and the Pad Recorder.

📖 DJ mode guide

Calm & genres

Calm when it should be, loud when it should be

GlowBop reads what kind of song is playing and picks lights to match. Movie scores, chill and jazz stay calm and flowing. Rock, hip-hop, Latin, country and kids songs each get their own looks. Nothing to set up.

  • Calm pack: 12 calm effects and four looks: Cinematic, Concert Hall, Jazz Club and Moonlit. Epic, chill and jazz songs stay calm, with no harsh strobes.
  • Auto genres: Rock gets Rock Arena, hip-hop Velvet Bounce, Latin and Afrobeats Tropicana, country and folk Golden Porch, kids songs Toy Box.
  • Holiday songs: a Christmas or Halloween song switches to the holiday show, in season.
  • Auto shows its guess on the MUSIC page, like "Auto · Rock". Not right? Tap Epic, Dance, Chill or the new Jazz light style and GlowBop remembers it for that artist.

📖 Calm & genres guide

Holidays

Holidays for wherever you live

Holidays live in their own section, away from the normal shuffle. GlowBop shows the holidays of your country, with the right dates, and the HOLIDAY key moves up the rail when one is near.

  • 23 holiday shows. Halloween, Christmas, Thanksgiving, New Year, Valentine's, St. Patrick's, the 4th of July, Birthday and Game Day.
  • 14 new from around the world: Diwali, Holi, Lunar New Year, Eid, Hanukkah, Easter, Carnival, Día de Muertos, Mother's Day, Bonfire Night, King's Day, Bastille Day, Canada Day and Australia Day.
  • Wide-screen mini-movies: Halloween Night, Harvest Day, Christmas Eve and New Year Countdown.
  • Jack-o'-lanterns, bats, ghosts, a haunted house, sleigh rides, fireworks, a ball drop and more.
  • Choose which holiday effects are in the rotation.

📖 Holidays guide

Draw your layout

Effects that follow your real shapes

Photograph your house or stage, or start from a blank grid, and draw where each light string runs. Use lines, paths, arcs, rings, boxes, pixel grids, or one-tap templates.

  • 10 templates: roofline, window, door, arch, pillar wrap, cone tree, spiral tree, stage truss, DJ booth and pixel panel.
  • Hide bulbs tucked behind gutters. Tap Test to see each string's start, end and direction.
  • 8 shape-aware effects follow your real shapes: spirals climb trees, light runs down from the roof peaks, arches pulse from the top, and windows light up in turn on the beat.
  • Every named string becomes a zone.
  • Night camera mapping: map at night, one light at a time, with the phone on a tripod. GlowBop sets the brightness for you, shows how many bulbs it saw and can retry the missing ones. Then line the pieces up in the editor.

📖 Draw your layout guide

Live feeds

The outside world, live on your lights

Tap LIVE and pick a feed. It takes over the wall until you turn it off. Set your ZIP code or city once for weather, storms and what's overhead.

  • Countdown to anything, with giant seconds at the end and a fireworks finale.
  • Weather: big temperature over an animated pixel sky, today's high and low, the next hours.
  • Storm watch: flashes new warnings over the music, only if you turn it on: the National Weather Service in the US, and outside the US GDACS cyclones and floods, MeteoAlarm in 38 European countries or any national alert feed. Tap Stop any time.
  • Overhead now: planes flying over your house and the space station.

📖 Live feeds guide

Scoreboard

Game Day, Live Fan and F1

Turn the wall into a scoreboard. Keep score yourself from your phone, follow a real game, or watch a Grand Prix.

  • Game Day: 15 sports, clock that counts down or up, periods, timeouts, fouls, possession, undo.
  • Live Fan: pick a league and team; scores update every 10 seconds and the wall celebrates in team colors.
  • Live stats: the count, runners on base, batter and pitcher, the last play scrolling by, down and distance, plus a Game Center on your phone.
  • F1: running order, tyres, pit stops, fastest lap, DRS and rain.
  • Countdown timer: a huge clock for halftime, a party or New Year.

📖 Scoreboard guide

Text & logos

Your words, your logo

Put a message or a logo on top of the show. Great for birthdays, DJ sets, and businesses.

  • Modes: Scroll, Beat words, Still and On drop.
  • Colors that follow the look, rainbow, or plain white.
  • Upload a logo (PNG) with Glow, Pulse or Color-shift motion.
  • Flash a word on every drop.

📖 Text & logo guide

Fireplace

Nine kinds of fire

Light a fire on your wall with one tap. GlowBop simulates real flames live, so the fire never loops and never looks the same twice.

  • 9 styles: Fireplace, Campfire, Bonfire, Candle wall, Torch row, Pixel flames, Spirit fire, Lava rising and Dragon breath.
  • 9 colors: Classic, Blue gas, Purple, Rainbow, Green, Pink, Ice, Team colors (your two colors) and Night shift (slowly drifts through the colors all night).
  • Cozy or Roaring, and Dance so the flames swell with your music.
  • Flare on the beat: every kick sends the flames up, and loud parts blow gusts of wind through them.

📖 Fireplace guide

Flow pack

Silk, ink and tides for melodic music

Melodic bass, progressive and chillstep get their own Flow style with two new looks, Trip and Silk, and 14 flowy effects.

  • Silk and ribbons, liquid and ink, waves and tides and particle flocks like a murmuration of birds.
  • Every flow effect has two moods: dreamy for the verses and a bigger drop mood when the song lands.
  • They join the auto show by themselves when Auto hears flowing music.

📖 Flow pack guide

Multi-curtain

Up to 8 curtains, one wall

Hang curtains side by side, stack them, or build a grid of rows and columns. GlowBop treats them as one big screen and resizes every show to fit, keeping pixel art crisp.

  • Grid walls: tap a shape like 2 × 2, 3 × 2 or 4 × 2 for up to 8 curtains.
  • A line-up wizard shows a number and arrow on each curtain so you can rotate, flip and order them.
  • Lock it in so nothing moves by accident.
  • Run them as one show or split them into groups with their own shows.
  • It all lives on the LIGHTS tab of the console.

📖 Line-up guide

Epic mode

Made for movie music

Cinematic songs don't have a "drop". They swell for minutes and peak once. GlowBop notices and switches to Epic mode on its own.

  • A slow, growing swell through the crescendo.
  • One big climax at the real peak, not every loud moment.
  • No harsh strobes during the quiet, emotional parts.
  • Optional song lookup uses free genre data to spot soundtracks even faster.

📖 About Epic mode

Big Wave

Waves that roll across the wall

A new family of flowing effects with its own look. A giant wave crests on the beat, a serpent swims the length of your wall with a glowing head, twin waves cross and an ocean swell rolls in slow.

  • Big Wave, Serpent, Twin Waves and Ocean Swell.
  • Their own Big Wave look, and they show up in Molten, Neon Party and Storm & Sea too.
  • Smooth on one curtain, spectacular across eight.

📖 Big Wave in the guide

Live science

Earthquakes, auroras and rocket launches

Seven new feeds turn real science data into a show. Each one has a preview button, so you can see it before the real thing happens.

  • Earthquakes drop on a world map or a spinning globe with a ripple, and can flash over the music when a big one hits.
  • Aurora curtains grow taller and brighter with the live space weather (the Kp index), with a gold flash for solar flares.
  • Rocket launches: the next launches, a countdown and liftoff on the wall.
  • Moon & sun: tonight's phase, sunrise, sunset and golden hour.
  • Globe: the Earth spinning with the day's quakes, storms, volcanoes and launches on it.
  • Volcanoes and wildfires near you or around the world. For nearby fire hotspots, add your own free NASA FIRMS key.

📖 Live science feeds

3D shapes

Bend your lights into art

Wrap your curtains around a cylinder, a box or a globe. GlowBop knows the shape, blends the seam so the picture goes all the way round, and plays effects made for 3D.

  • Cylinder, box or globe, with an optional lid curtain on top.
  • 3D effects: Spinning Globe, Barber Spin, Rising Rings and Bounce Ball in the 3D Object look.
  • A 3D preview in the app you can drag to spin.

📖 3D shapes guide

Games

Games that play themselves

GAMES has its own key on the rail. Tap a game and it plays itself across your wall, speeding up with the music. Or start the Arcade marathon and GlowBop plays them all in turn.

  • 8 games: Breakout, Snake, Pong, Alien parade, Space rocks, Block drop, Light cycles and Game of life.
  • Breakout: bricks burst into sparks. Snake: a rainbow snake hunts glowing food.
  • Pong: the ball smashes on the beat.
  • Tap the playing game again to turn it off, or tap ♫ Back to music under the wall.

📖 Games in the guide

Wild Elements

Weather and nature, wired to the beat

A volcano that erupts on the drop, a tornado that wanders across the wall, rain on the window, a waterfall and the surface of the sun.

  • Volcano: lava bombs fly on the drop.
  • Tornado: debris spins faster as the song builds.
  • Rain on glass, Waterfall, Solar flare.

See them in the gallery

Formula 1

Race day on your wall

The running order lives on your wall in team colors, and every big moment of the race gets its own show: the overtake for the lead, the safety car, the chequered flag.

  • Live timing: position, driver, team color tab, tyre dot and the lap count, updating every few seconds.
  • DRS attack bar: a flashing bar grows under a driver as they close inside one second.
  • NEW LEADER, WINNER and POLE explode in the driver's team colors.
  • Purple for the fastest lap, flashing yellow for the safety car, red flag, chequered flag and rain falling on the wall.
  • Pit stops get a soft flash. Works for practice, qualifying, sprints and the race.

📖 F1 board guide

Screen mirror

Your screen, on the lights

Mirror the laptop screen onto the wall: TV shows, music videos, games.

  • Styles: TV, Beat and Glow.
  • Smart fill trims black bars so the video fills the wall.
  • Center zoom for bigger, bolder shapes.

📖 Screen mirror guide

xLights houses

Your holiday display, dancing live

Already run a holiday light show with xLights? Point GlowBop at your xLights show folder. It reads your props and your controllers and plays live, music-reactive shows on your whole house, with no sequencing.

  • Reads your show folder: rooflines, arches, candy canes, mega trees, matrices, windows and custom props, placed just like your house preview.
  • Uses the controllers you already own: Falcon, Kulp, HinksPix, ESPixelStick and WLED over E1.31 (sACN), DDP or Art-Net.
  • Your model groups become zones, and trees and arches get the shape effects: spirals up the mega tree, arches pulsing from the top.
  • Running Falcon Player? Put it in bridge mode for the night, or let GlowBop send at a higher priority. One tap on Hand back to my show and your schedule picks up again.
  • In the works: we will mark it supported once we have run it on a real xLights house.

See supported lights
